SELECT u.user_name AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM ( SELECT c.user_sender_id AS teacher_id FROM chat c JOIN user sender ON c.user_sender_id = sender.id AND sender.role_id = 2 JOIN user receiver ON c.user_receiver_id = receiver.id AND receiver.role_id = 3
UNION ALL
SELECT c.user_receiver_id AS teacher_id FROM chat c JOIN user sender ON c.user_sender_id = sender.id AND sender.role_id = 3 JOIN user receiver ON c.user_receiver_id = receiver.id AND receiver.role_id = 2 ) AS comm JOIN user u ON comm.teacher_id = u.id GROUP BY comm.teacher_id ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 5
